It appears that adding `0.00001` to `-400` results in `-400` due to floating point inaccuracies. After that, the for loop is being reset (`i = -1`) without changing any other state. This cycle then continues until the heat death of the universe. An easy fix is to change the type of `safe_offset` from a `float` to a `double`. But this might kick the bug down the road. For reference, the offending method is `float CurveEdit::get_offset_without_collision(int, float, bool)` at curve_editor_plugin.cpp:472
